facts.note: The hall is thirty-one blocks wall to wall, which is the span the barred wall divides in two.
Eight blocks floor to vault, so the loft can sit above head height and still be looked up at from the near side.
Three doors pierce the barred wall, which is why the graph carries three barred connections between the same two places rather than one.
The annex is four tiles long, set down by its program by name: an entry, the bay twice, a cap.
The site's span: the hall, the annex and the long hall side by side, four blocks of rock between each.
The site's depth: the long hall, the longest of the three, and a block of rock at either end.
